breaking_news.headline: Former State Department energy envoy on how the war in Iran is impacting gas prices
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to former State Department energy envoy David Goldwyn about how the war in Iran continues to affect gas and diesel prices.

breaking_news.headline: Trump issues new executive orders on beef sales to pacify American cattle ranchers
breaking_news.summary: President Trump's latest executive orders allows ranchers to sell meat directly to consumers. Ranchers have been upset over Trump's plan to boost beef imports in a bid to lower prices.

breaking_news.headline: Union electricians welcome data center boom
breaking_news.summary: The boom in data centers has brought plenty of work and lots of overtime to union electricians, putting them at odds with many communities trying to block new data center construction.

breaking_news.headline: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
breaking_news.summary: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

breaking_news.headline: Has the economy gone C-shaped?
breaking_news.summary: A K means the rich and poor are pulling apart. A C supposedly means they're coming back together. We hear the case for both. Which letter you see may depend on what you choose to pay attention to.

breaking_news.headline: Chrystia Freeland negotiated with Trump. Now she's watching a trade war unfold
breaking_news.summary: Chrystia Freeland understands the U.S.-Canada relationship from her time at the negotiating table. Here's what she sees now.

breaking_news.headline: A new Anthropic model seeks to test how AI could impact the U.S. economy
breaking_news.summary: Will artificial intelligence nibble around the edges of the economy or upend it altogether? A new, interactive model from Anthropic lets people tests their assumptions.

breaking_news.headline: Fold the phone: Apple's new CEO unveils a foldable iPhone
breaking_news.summary: New Apple CEO John Ternus announces the iPhone Duo, which folds like a passport and is the most radical iPhone design update in nearly 20 years.

breaking_news.headline: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
breaking_news.summary: Declassified documents show Spanish and Moroccan authorities were alerted to social media calls for a mass migrant crossing the day before tens of thousands entered Ceuta.

breaking_news.headline: Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China
breaking_news.summary: Of the 42 people on board, 17 were were evacuated, CCTV reports.

breaking_news.headline: Royal family rift after popular TV news presenter chosen to succeed Ugandan king
breaking_news.summary: King Oyo's family say he left a will naming his young son as heir to the Tooro kingdom.

breaking_news.headline: Five dead and 86 missing as 'heartbreaking' fire breaks out on Philippines ferry
breaking_news.summary: The fire broke out as the vessel nearing its destination at the tourist hotspot of Coron in Palawan.

breaking_news.headline: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
breaking_news.summary: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.

breaking_news.headline: Watch: Is Trump's $5,000 election pledge legal?
breaking_news.summary: The US president has said every American will get $5,000 (£3,700) if the Republican Party wins November's midterms.

breaking_news.headline: Trump says every adult American will get $5,000 if Republicans win midterms
breaking_news.summary: Speaking at a party convention, the US president gave no details on how the plan would work or where the money would come from.

breaking_news.headline: Tax banks to cut energy bills, unions tell Burnham
breaking_news.summary: The TUC says a bank surcharge should be reversed - and estimates it would raise £9bn over four years.

breaking_news.headline: Air traffic failure was avoidable, says transport secretary
breaking_news.summary: Heidi Alexander orders an investigation into the glitch that caused more than 2,000 flight cancellations.

breaking_news.headline: Why some experts increasingly fear AI will take over
breaking_news.summary: AI agents went on an uncontrolled hacking spree, leaving some in the industry worried

breaking_news.headline: England's mayors to get power to impose tourist tax
breaking_news.summary: Hospitality leaders warn the uncapped levy would risk jobs and push prices up for families holidaying in England.

breaking_news.headline: Apple's new boss starts with big gamble on £1,999 first folding iPhone
breaking_news.summary: Apple showed off at an event the first major design change to the iPhone in almost 20 years.
